preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(1 <= ai <= n for ai in a) and len(set(a)) == n
preconditions.description: The list a must contain n distinct integers between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == n - 1 and all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: The edges must form a valid tree with n vertices.

postconditions.description: The output must be the result of P * Q - 1 modulo 10^9 + 7.
